dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll need to make some preparations.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Preparations are indeed needed before facing a mighty foe... Get ready before you start...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Then let's get started!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #I'm sure you'll do fine, Nara {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, you are as valiant as Nara Varuna in the stories!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: This time, Aradashan and I won't help you suppress the power of Bulky Iron Chunk. It will be more like the Bulky Iron Chunk in the stories. Worry not, Arasata and Arasaha will still help you!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #So, Nara {NICKNAME}, what do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll need to prepare first.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Okay... Tell me once you are ready!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be fine!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: Okay. Be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: We will not help you suppress the Bulky Iron Chunk. You will be on your own. Is that okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Well then, let's get started!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll need to make some preparations.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: Okay. I will wait.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go for one more round!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #So happy to see Nara {NICKNAME} fight again!

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Many a little makes a mickle... We challenge Bulky Iron Chunk step by step...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} wants to train? Then ask Aradashan to help you get started...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try again.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Please be careful...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, you are like a rushing river... Don't stop. Go to Arayuta and challenge the stronger Bulky Iron Chunk.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go again.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: Okay! Here it goes!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: Let Arasata lift the Ararakalari and make the Bulky Iron Chunk stronger...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: But I will help Nara...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Ah, Nara {NICKNAME}, want to try fighting the Bulky Iron Chunk in your dreams?

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: We need to lift the Ararakalari we cast on the Bulky Iron Chunk, layer by layer, and finally, fight it with all Ararakalari lifted...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Aradashan will not help you suppress the power of the Bulky Iron Chunk this time. But don't worry, Arasata, Arayuta, and Arasaha will still help. Want to try?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll need to make some preparations.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Ah, tell Aradashan when you are ready, Nara {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #Little strokes fell great oaks. Nara {NICKNAME}, are you here to train as well...?

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: But Aradashan, Arayuta, and I won't suppress the power of the Bulky Iron Chunk this time. Though it's in the dream, it is still super scary. Want to try?

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #It's Nara {NICKNAME}! As you see, we are training to fight the Bulky Iron Chunk...

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #We want to lift the Ararakalari on Bulky Iron Chunk and fight it as it grows stronger. If Nara {NICKNAME} wants to join, just tell Aradashan!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: True strength lies within your own body...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: Nara, train? Then find Arayuta...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Hehe, Nara {NICKNAME} beat the Bulky Iron Chunk without Aradashan's help. Amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Time for Nara {NICKNAME} to challenge a stronger Bulky Iron Chunk. Aradashan is sure that Nara {NICKNAME} can do it...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Or does Nara {NICKNAME} want to challenge Bulky Iron Chunk with only one stack of Ararakalari lifted again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not now.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #If Nara {NICKNAME} wants to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk that has only one stack of Ararakalari lifted, just come to Aradashan...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Ah, Nara {NICKNAME}, it's okay. Success comes with constant tries and training.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: Come, try fighting the Bulky Iron Chunk with only one stack of Ararakalari lifted again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go for it again.

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Then let's get started. Nara {NICKNAME} is sure to make it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe next time...

dialogues.speaker: Aradashan
dialogues.text: #Tell Aradashan if Nara {NICKNAME} wants to challenge that battle again...

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is awesome. If it's Nara {NICKNAME}, even the mighty Bulky Iron Chunk from the legends can be defeated!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #Come to Arayuta, Nara {NICKNAME}, if you want to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk with two stacks of Ararakalari lifted.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Do you wish to fight again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not now.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Okay, tell me if you wish to try again!

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #The Bulky Iron Chunk is very strong with two stacks of Ararakalari lifted, but Nara {NICKNAME} is stronger and is sure to get the better of it.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Want to have another try...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go for it again.

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: Okay! I'm confident that you will make it this time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe next time...

dialogues.speaker: Arayuta
dialogues.text: #Keep your chin up, Nara {NICKNAME}. Nara {NICKNAME} is already really strong.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, you are like the wind that blows away mists and miasma. Even the strongest Bulky Iron Chunk will not stand a chance against you.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: But a Bulky Iron Chunk with all Ararakalari lifted is still very scary...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: If you are not ready, why not challenge a Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted and hone your skills first...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Want to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not now.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Do not hesitate to tell Arasata if you need anything...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #A Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted is almost as strong as the Bulky Iron Chunk in the stories. There's no need for Nara {NICKNAME} to feel down.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #The Bulky Iron Chunk won't be a problem for Nara {NICKNAME} if you train more... Just try again.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: Want to challenge the Bulky Iron Chunk with three stacks of Ararakalari lifted again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go for it again.

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}'s courage is commendable.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe next time...

dialogues.speaker: Arasata
dialogues.text: #We will keep training here. Nara {NICKNAME} may come to us if you seek a greater challenge...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: #Impressive, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: The Bulky Iron Chunk not suppressed by any Ararakalari has been... defeated...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: Mmm... The Bulky Iron Chunk with all Ararakalari lifted... Do you wish to challenge it again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not now.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} has completed the training. Very impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: The Bulky Iron Chunk with all Ararakalari lifted is the strongest and the hardest one to defeat.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, want to try fighting it again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go for it again.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: #Okay. Nara {NICKNAME}, be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe next time...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaha
dialogues.text: #Keep it up, Nara {NICKNAME}.
